'''Metalic_Jaguar Maul's Revenge''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Metalic_Jaguar]]
* '''Published:''' 28 January 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections III]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Executor: Holotheatre|Dagobah-D-executorholotheatre.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Executor: Holotheatre
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PR3 Executor Holotheatre Metalic_Jaguar MaulsRev.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

This is MAUL'S REVENGE!

Review for me please and give me advice.
